## Intent

Disk Steward users can discover supported local AI clients, explicitly select one or more, and safely set up, verify, repair, or remove the read-only Disk Steward MCP integration without manually editing configuration files or confusing client setup with Agent Access.

## Success Evidence

- `REQ-401` — Settings detects supported installed clients through bounded known signals and lets the user select one or several targets without treating unknown software as supported. (covered by: CONTRACT-401, GATE-490, GATE-590, INTENT-004, OUTCOME-410, OUTCOME-420, TASK-402, TASK-403, TASK-501)
- `REQ-402` — Setup, verification, repair, and removal are idempotent, preserve unrelated client configuration, refuse conflicting ownership, and provide recoverable evidence for every mutation. (covered by: CONTRACT-401, GATE-490, GATE-590, INTENT-004, OUTCOME-410, OUTCOME-420, TASK-402, TASK-501, TASK-502)
- `REQ-403` — The UI distinguishes detection, configuration, client approval, verification, broken configuration, and Agent Access state with accessible text and per-client outcomes. (covered by: CONTRACT-401, GATE-490, GATE-590, INTENT-004, OUTCOME-410, OUTCOME-420, TASK-403, TASK-502)
- `REQ-404` — Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and Claude Desktop receive an honest supported setup path, while other MCP clients receive a copyable manual configuration rather than guessed mutation. (covered by: GATE-590, INTENT-004, OUTCOME-420, TASK-501, TASK-502)
- `REQ-405` — The signed application bundle exposes a stable read-only helper path, and automated tests prove install, upgrade, conflict, verification, removal, and unrelated-setting preservation behavior. (covered by: CONTRACT-401, GATE-490, GATE-590, INTENT-004, OUTCOME-410, OUTCOME-420, TASK-402, TASK-502)

## Residual Risks

- CONTRACT-401: Client-owned approval cannot always be verified from Disk Steward and must remain an explicit approvalPending state.
- TASK-402: A client CLI output-format change will fail as malformed instead of guessing or editing an unknown configuration.
- TASK-403: GUI clients without an installed command-line setup path remain explicitly unavailable until their adapters land in TASK-501.
- TASK-501: Client-owned deep links can only be marked configured after the client writes the accepted entry; until then the state remains approval-pending.
- TASK-502: No native Cursor/VS Code UI approval or Claude Desktop launch was automated; these paths are intentionally client-owned and tested through URL/document contracts.
- TASK-502: No uncooperative-writer atomic compare-and-swap is supplied by native CLI APIs; immediate reads and conservative rollback refuse observed conflicts.
- TASK-502: Executable stat identity detects normal updates/replacements; it is not a cryptographic authenticity check.
- TASK-502: No signing, notarization, installation, commit, push, publication, or broader scanner completion is claimed.
